# MarketLens

> World of Warcraft auction-house market screener and observed-population survey.
> Market data comes from TradeSkillMaster public region data; realm-specific market
> and population data are uploaded by the MarketLens in-game addon. Base URL:
> https://marketlens.skarz.workers.dev

The human-facing pages (/ and /item/...) fill their tables client-side from the
JSON API below, so fetching that HTML without running JavaScript returns only a
placeholder. Fetch the JSON endpoints directly instead — they are the source of
truth and are edge-cached.

## Conventions

- `<game>` is a dataset key. Region datasets: `classic-progression` (TBC
  Anniversary), `classic` (Classic Era), `retail`. Uploaded realms:
  `realm:<RealmName>` or `realm:<RealmName>-<Faction>`, e.g.
  `realm:Ashkandi-Alliance`. Call /api/games for the live list.
- Money values (mv, asp, hist) are in copper. 100 copper = 1 silver; 10000
  copper = 1 gold.
- `sr` is a sale rate from 0 to 1. `spd` is estimated items sold per day.
- Realm-only fields (`q`, `sc`, `tc`, `cat`) are null on region datasets.

## API

- [/api/games](https://marketlens.skarz.workers.dev/api/games): Every dataset
  present, each with `game`, `label`, `count`, `updatedAt`, `realm`, `hasItems`,
  `hasPop`, `sourceGame`.
- [/api/items?game=<game>](https://marketlens.skarz.workers.dev/api/items?game=classic-progression):
  Latest market snapshot for a dataset. Returns `game`, `sourceGame`, `region`,
  `count`, `updatedAt`, `days`, `columns`, and `items`. `items` is an array of
  arrays; `columns` names each position. Current order:
  `["id","name","slug","mv","asp","sr","spd","q","sc","tc","hist","cat"]` where
  mv=market value, asp=average sale price, sr=sale rate, spd=sold/day,
  q=quantity on the realm AH, sc=distinct sellers, tc=top-seller concentration
  (0-100, the largest single seller's share of listed quantity), hist=region
  historical avg (for the realm-vs-region deal signal), cat=category.
- [/api/history?game=<game>&id=<itemId>](https://marketlens.skarz.workers.dev/api/history?game=classic-progression&id=2589):
  Daily time series for one item. Returns `points`, an array of objects with
  `ts` (YYYYMMDD integer), `mv`, `asp`, `sr`, `spd`.
- [/api/population?game=realm:<realm>](https://marketlens.skarz.workers.dev/api/population?game=realm:Ashkandi-Alliance):
  Observed population survey sampled via in-game /who. Returns `realm`,
  `faction`, `samples`, `sightings`, `perDayUnique`, `updatedAt`, `classes`
  (token -> count), `races` (token -> count), `demand` (inferred profession
  demand: array of `{prof, weight, score}`), and `characters` (unique/returning
  counts and a recent-activity roster).

## Notes

- Demand scores are inferred from region sale rate and volume, or (on the
  population survey) from the observed class mix — never from observed sales.
- A /who sample is currently-visible online players (server-capped, ~50 per
  scan), not a census. Character names identify characters, not people.
